needs.reason: No library version is written: the dependency-management plugin imports the spring-boot-dependencies BOM matching the Boot plugin version 3.4.0, which fixes the starters to 3.4.0, postgresql to 42.7.4 and, through the junit-bom it imports, junit-platform-launcher to 1.11.3 (checked in spring-boot-dependencies-3.4.0.pom: postgresql.version 42.7.4, junit-jupiter.version 5.11.3, hibernate.version 6.6.2.Final). Only a resolution, or a reader of that BOM, knows them.

traps: Every library version comes from the Boot plugin version 3.4.0 through io.spring.dependency-management: change the plugin version and every library moves.
developmentOnly is a configuration created by the Boot plugin: spring-boot-docker-compose is on the classpath of bootRun but not packaged in bootJar, so it is a dev dependency.

The database is configured nowhere in application.yml: at startup spring-boot-docker-compose reads compose.yaml, starts postgres:16 and supplies the JDBC URL, user and password. A reader of the Spring configuration alone finds no service.
Hibernate ORM 6.6.2.Final arrives only through spring-boot-starter-data-jpa; no line names it.
junit-platform-launcher 1.11.3 is managed by the junit-bom imported by spring-boot-dependencies, not by the Boot version itself.
compose.yaml names port 5432 on the container side only: the host port is random.
resolved for every library is read from spring-boot-dependencies 3.4.0 (and the junit-bom 5.11.3 it imports) as published on Maven Central.
